Introduction

Goo Hyun is a South Korean singer under OAK Company. He is a member of the boy group BE BOYS and a former pre-debut member of the boy group PLATINUM78 and EASTSHINE.

He is also known for being a contestant on the survival shows Fantasy Boys, Fan Pick and Project 7.
